title: Advanced Java Interview Questions and Answers - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Advanced Java interview questions primarily focus on real-world backend development concepts, including JDBC, Servlets, JSP, Hibernate, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, REST APIs, Spring Data, AOP, Security, Cloud Computing, Microservices, Struts, and JUnit testing.

Topic-wise Interview Questions

Let's explore some important topic-wise interview questions from Advanced Java technologies that help evaluate a candidate’s understanding of backend development frameworks and tools used in real-world Java applications.

  • Introduction to Advanced Java
  • JDBC (Java Database Connectivity)
  • Java Servlets
  • JSP (Java Server Pages)
  • Hibernate (ORM Framework)
  • Spring Framework
  • Spring Boot
  • Spring MVC
  • Spring Data Jpa
  • Spring Security
  • Spring Cloud
  • Struts Framework
  • Java Microservices
  • JUnit Testing

Relevant Resources

The following resources provide detailed tutorials to help you learn important Advanced Java technologies and frameworks used in modern backend development.

  • Advanced Java Tutorial
  • JDBC Complete Tutorial
  • Hibernate Complete Tutorial
  • Spring Complete Tutorial
  • Spring Data JPA Tutorial
  • Spring Boot Complete Tutorial
  • Spring MVC Complete Tutorial
  • Spring Security Complete Tutorial
  • Java Design Patterns Tutorial
  • Microservices Complete Tutorial
